Here is a transcription of the historical Latin marriage register entries shown in `image_847f47.png`.

The entries are written in a standard Latin formula for Catholic parish registers, typically following the structure: *Die [Day] [Month] [Year], [Groom] et [Bride]. Coram [Witness 1] et [Witness 2]. Joannes Quinlan PP (or CC/v.v.)* (meaning "In the presence of [Witnesses], Joannes Quinlan, Parish Priest/Curate").
